criteria.text: All current partial declarations have an inventory entry naming file, type, project, namespace, category, caller, mutable-state writer, lifetime/dispose owner, and binding/public contract impact.
Every proposed extraction has a current owner, intended owner, call path, dependency direction, state/data flow, and focused proof; candidates without a real boundary are recorded as no-change.
Each implemented extraction changes a real responsibility or dependency boundary, removes stale coupling from the former owner, and preserves observable contracts.
Every implemented slice passes the relevant Debug/Release build, focused contract or smoke check, stale-coupling search, and git diff whitespace check.
A final report records the retained generated/cohesive partials, moved responsibilities, old/new call paths, build/test evidence, and runtime boundaries that remain unverified.

The completion design names the current and intended owner, call path, mutable-state writer, lifetime/release owner, and binding/public/test contract for every remaining manual family and protected framework family.

The final implementation removes manual partial declarations from OpenGlDrawing, Recipe CommandSurface, and Shell TestHooks without changing existing public, XAML, Recipe XML, OpenGL, or smoke contracts.
The final audit reports compiled declarations separately from literal partial text matches and closes with the protected framework set plus focused build/test evidence.

evidence.observation: A source/tools inventory excluding bin and obj found 108 actual partial declarations across 65 partial types. 58 declarations were classified as generated/framework or XAML contracts and 50 as cohesive same-lifetime composition. Two additional raw partial tokens were smoke-contract strings and were recorded separately as non-declaration matches.

P2 rechecked 12 cohesive partial families. The recipe command surface shares binding and execution state; the dock workspace shares one AvalonDock manager; Pipeline Review events share document state and Dispose subscriptions; Shell/TestHooks share the public smoke contract and private owners; ImageCanvas/ROI/OpenGL/docking/tool shells share native or visual lifetimes. Zero independently owned extraction boundaries were proven.
